items.title: Staff, sword, and symbol
must: Every weapon and tool is one whole, correctly built object that is gripped by a visible hand, sheathed, or resting on a surface; nothing floats in the air

All three objects lie flat on the stone side by side, none crossing or resting on another, each touching the stone along its whole length with its shadow directly beneath it; both ends of the staff are on the stone
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the Magic in the Dying Lands altar still life.
